newsitem.title: UK: Lonrho to take charge on Uzbek gold project.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho to take charge on Uzbek gold project.

text.p: British conglomerate Lonrho Plc said on Thursday it would take a 15 million stg charge in its half-year results to cover exploration costs for its Amantaytau gold project in Uzbekistan.
Lonrho said it would not incur further significant costs on Amantaytau following the completion of its six-month review of the project, which has more than five million ounces of gold reserves.
"The review demonstrated that there had been a substantial increase in both capital and operational costs and a resultant reduction in the projected return," Lonrho said in a statement.
The company said neither it nor its partner, Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd, were prepared to take the project forward on that basis.

"Lonrho remains interested in the project and is cooperating with the Uzbek government and other potential partners with the objective of establishing a basis for the commercial development of Amantaytau," the firm said.
Regarding its earnings, the company said its expected gain of over 125 million stg on the recent sale of Lonrho Sugar Corp would benefit second-half results.
Lonrho agreed earlier this month to sell the sugar unit to South Africa's Illovo Sugar Ltd.
